claims.text:
stage computation: Two unique complete corpus records with identical prefix “port”: recordA completes “east”; recordB completes “west”. Training multiset[A,A,A,B]. Frequency-fit P(east)=3/4. Exact-content deduplication gives[A,B], P(east)=1/2. Duplicating B to4 copies while A remains3 gives raw P(east)=3/7, deduplicated still1/2.

**Countercase / boundary:** This estimator counts records; it is not a neural model or empirical memorization law. Distinct genuine records with same completion are not necessarily duplicates. Only exact identical full records are collapsed here. Removing a duplicate need not remove the unique content or prove privacy.

**Prediction / transfer recall:** Predict effect of adding another copy of A; recall raw[A,A,B] gives2/3 while deduplicated remains1/2.

**Intervention / reachable witness:** Add A / Add B / Deduplicate changes visible occurrence stacks and fitted probability. Keep raw and unique-record counts separately; retain primary3/4→1/2 witness through changed duplicate mix. No user corpus or external text is used.
